terms.comment: Morgan–Owens records insulatio, citing Helfer; the brief entry does not specify a complete thermal-insulation system. In narration a description such as mūnīmentum adversus frīgus avoids the collision with īnsula; compare Columella 9.7.4, quod tegumen cum frīgora et pluviās tum et aestūs arcet.

sources: Morgan–Owens: insulation · Lewis & Short: munimentum
